cosmos-admindashboard-control-help-descr: Read guides made for wiki administrators
cosmos-admindashboard-control-js-descrip: Edit the JavaScript that runs on every page
cosmos-admindashboard-control-listfiles-: Browse all of the uploaded files
cosmos-admindashboard-control-managewiki: Manage core settings, extensions and permissions
cosmos-admindashboard-control-multipleup: Add several files in one go
cosmos-admindashboard-control-navigation: Edit the links in the wiki navigation menu
cosmos-admindashboard-control-newpages-d: See the pages that were created most recently
cosmos-admindashboard-control-recentchan: See the latest edits across the wiki
cosmos-admindashboard-control-sitenotice: Edit the message shown at the top of every page
cosmos-admindashboard-control-tagline-de: Edit the text shown beside the wiki name
cosmos-admindashboard-control-themedesig: Change colors, images and layout of the skin
cosmos-admindashboard-control-upload-des: Add an image or another file to the wiki
cosmos-admindashboard-control-userrights: Change which groups a user belongs to
cosmos-admindashboard-control-video-desc: Add a video to the wiki
cosmos-createpage-no-wanted-pages: or create one of the articles listed [[$1|here]]!
cosmos-createpage-text: We currently have '''$1''' {{PLURAL:$1|article|articles}} on $2. Type your article name above $3
cosmos-createpage-wanted-pages: or click on one of the titles below and start writing!
cosmos-desc: Cosmos is a skin designed and based off Fandom's Oasis skin. Designed to improve upon their design, and provide an efficient MediaWiki skin for non-Fandom users, or for users transitioning out of Fandom. If you wish, you may join the [https://discord.gg/GPVgFTaQTJ Cosmos Discord server] if you require assistance with theming or something else.
cosmos-legacyconverter-icons: Old icon classes were found and left as they are: $1. Icons are now drawn with CSS, so rules that set fill or target svg need to use color on the icon instead.
cosmos-legacyconverter-intro: Paste old Cosmos CSS or JavaScript to rewrite its class names to the current skin-cosmos- names. Only class names in selectors, class lists and markup strings are changed. Review the result before saving it to your wiki.
cosmos-legacyconverter-nochanges: No old Cosmos classes were found.
cosmos-legacyconverter-toolarge: The pasted code is larger than the maximum page size.
cosmos-themedesigner-advanced-help: The theme as JSON. Anything invalid is ignored when you publish.
cosmos-themedesigner-color-banner-help: Background of the bar with search and the user menu.
cosmos-themedesigner-color-content-help: Background of articles and the rail.
cosmos-themedesigner-color-header-help: Background of the wiki name and navigation tabs.
cosmos-themedesigner-color-invalid: That is not a color the designer understands.
cosmos-themedesigner-color-toolbar-help: Background of the page tools at the bottom.
cosmos-themedesigner-colors-intro: Use the picker or type any CSS color. Reset a color to go back to its default.
cosmos-themedesigner-darkmode-auto-help: Automatic shows the light colors, and switches to the dark colors for visitors whose browser or device asks for a dark color scheme. Their own choice with the switch always wins.
cosmos-themedesigner-darkmode-builtin: The switch is a button in the wiki header. Logged in users keep their choice in their preferences. Visitors keep it in their browser.
cosmos-themedesigner-darkmode-generate: Make dark colors from the light ones
cosmos-themedesigner-darkmode-generated: Dark colors made. Check them under Colors, then publish.
cosmos-themedesigner-darkmode-intro: Cosmos has a dark mode of its own. Each mode keeps its own colors, so you can edit them separately under Colors.
cosmos-themedesigner-darkmode-toggle: Let people switch between light and dark
cosmos-themedesigner-error-json: The theme data could not be read.
cosmos-themedesigner-error-permission: You do not have permission to change the theme.
cosmos-themedesigner-error-token: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
cosmos-themedesigner-europa-help: Gives infoboxes from the PortableInfobox extension the Europa look. Without it they use the default look.
cosmos-themedesigner-file-upload-comment: Uploaded from the Cosmos theme designer
cosmos-themedesigner-file-upload-exists: A file with that name already exists. Rename it and try again.
cosmos-themedesigner-file-upload-failed: The file could not be uploaded.
cosmos-themedesigner-font-custom-help: Font names separated by commas, such as Georgia, serif. Visitors need the fonts on their device, or the wiki has to load them in MediaWiki:Common.css.
cosmos-themedesigner-font-file-help: A WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF file. Choose one that is already on the wiki or upload a new one.
cosmos-themedesigner-font-file-unavailab: This wiki does not accept font files yet. An administrator has to add woff2, woff, ttf or otf to $wgFileExtensions first.
cosmos-themedesigner-font-preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 0123456789
cosmos-themedesigner-footer-hidden-help: These are the footer links that exist on this wiki.
cosmos-themedesigner-footer-icons-locked: The configuration of this wiki does not allow hiding the footer icons.
cosmos-themedesigner-history-intro: Every published theme is kept. Restoring one publishes it again as the newest version.
cosmos-themedesigner-images-intro: Type a file name from this wiki, pick an uploaded file, upload a new image, or use a full web address. Leave a field empty to use its default.
cosmos-themedesigner-layout-backdrop-blu: Background blur behind see through areas
Blurs what is behind the banner, content area, footer and page tools when their colors are see through. Browsers that cannot blur get a more opaque background instead.
cosmos-themedesigner-layout-button-style: The look of the edit, cancel and other buttons above the page title.
cosmos-themedesigner-layout-font-help: The font used across the wiki. Fonts other than your own uploads must already be on the visitor's device.
cosmos-themedesigner-layout-header-borde: Draws a thin line below the page title and the page buttons, separating them from the content.
cosmos-themedesigner-nojs: The theme designer needs JavaScript. You can still edit the settings under Advanced.
cosmos-themedesigner-preset-applied: Palette applied. Publish to make it live.
cosmos-themedesigner-presets-intro: Pick a ready made palette. It replaces the colors for its mode, and you can still change each color afterwards.
cosmos-themedesigner-protected: The configuration of this wiki does not allow hiding this link.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-anons: Hide the rail from visitors who are not logged in
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-custom-exists: A module for that message already exists
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-custom-invalid: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-custom-message: The name of a page in the MediaWiki namespace, without the prefix. Its content becomes the module.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-intro: Choose when the rail appears, then set up each module in it on its own.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-module-places-: The lists below replace the rail ones for this module only. Leave both empty to show the module on every page.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-modules-help: Every module the rail can show on this wiki, including those added by extensions.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-namespaces-hel: Modules are hidden in these namespaces unless they have page rules of their own.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-pages-help: Modules are hidden on these pages unless they have page rules of their own.
cosmos-themedesigner-rail-pages-placehol: Search pages or type a title
cosmos-themedesigner-readonly: You can look at the current theme, but you do not have permission to change it.
cosmos-themedesigner-reset-all-confirm: Reset every setting to its default? Nothing goes live until you publish.
cosmos-themedesigner-reset-colors: Reset all colors for this mode
cosmos-themedesigner-text: Customize how the '''Cosmos''' skin looks on this wiki. Changes go live when you publish, and every published version is kept so you can go back to it.
cosmos-themedesigner-theme-only: The theme of this wiki is set here only. The theme settings in its configuration are not used.
cosmos-themedesigner-toolbar-hidden-help: These are the page tools that exist on this wiki.
cosmos-themedesigner-toolbar-rail-off: The rail is turned off, so the page tools will not show on any page.
cosmos-themedesigner-toolbar-style-help: The rail option puts the page tools in the rail as a module, so they only show on pages that have a rail. Where the rail shows is set under Rail.
cosmos.css: /* All CSS here will be loaded for users of the Cosmos skin */
cosmos.js: /* All JavaScript here will be loaded for users of the Cosmos skin */
